items.text: Rams officially listed WR Puka Nacua questionable (hip/groin soreness) for MNF vs Giants; Jordan Whittington doubtful (quad). McVay: pregame decision, different from camp psoas.
items.why: Groin soreness post-Thursday practice; missed Fri/Sat practices.
items.implication: GTD; roster pivot ready for MNF. If out, TE heavier usage + secondary WRs.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams primary bump; Konata Mumpfield/Malachi Fields if Whittington also out.

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated; downgraded Saturday after limited Friday practice.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups; Ravens WR targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for remaining BAL pass-catchers including Mark Andrews.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers listed doubtful; elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White from practice squad.
items.why: Knee (meniscus trim); will test pregame but doubtful tag rarely beaten.
items.implication: Plan without Bowers; TE streaming opportunity opens.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer inherits primary TE role and target share vs Chargers.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT (foot) vs Patriots.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; PIT WR targets to Metcalf/others.
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf and TE Freiermuth volume bump.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Sunday vs Bengals.
items.why: Hamstring suffered Wednesday; missed Thu/Fri practices.
items.implication: Sit Collins; HOU WR/TE volume opens.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz strong TE streamer; Hutchinson/Boutte deep volume.

items.text: ETR The Rundown Week 2 live early Sunday AM: game-by-game actionable takes, projections assumptions, cheap WR volume (QJ/Harris McConkey contingency), weather/odds updates.
items.why: Concise synthesis of ETR content for Sunday slate decisions.
items.implication: Primary source for status/beneficiary/projection adjustments pre-kickoff.

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow questionable (back) but expected to play vs Texans.
items.why: Back tightness; full Friday practice and coach comments positive.
items.implication: Start Burrow confidently; elevation is precautionary.

items.text: Ladd McConkey questionable (rib); Quentin Johnston and Tre’ Harris projected for large roles/5+ targets if out, both secured 22% shares post-McConkey exit in W1. Johnston >5 targets even if McConkey plays.
items.why: Rib injury; limited Friday return after two DNPs.
items.implication: Monitor late window; QJ/Harris contingency high-upside cheap volume vs Raiders.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston primary beneficiary and cheap WR volume play.
corroboration: @adamlevitan notes McConkey biggest Q impacting Herbert

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson cleared/full practice all week and expected active for season debut vs Steelers; 10+ touch potential but Stevenson retains majority early. Levitan flags hierarchy shift potential.
items.why: Ankle healed; full participant, self-declared ready.
items.implication: Henderson flex upside in split; Stevenson floor slightly lowered.
items.opportunity: Monitor snap share/carries for role expansion; handcuff value both ways.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% route targets (team lead). IND allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. High utilization RB4 with RB1 upside.
items.why: Elite W1 usage + soft matchup vs run-vulnerable Colts.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry share continues; goal-line involved.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rush attempts W1, 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role further; Saints underdogs bad script.
items.why: W1 reduced workload + Kamara return creates 3-headed committee risk.
items.implication: Fade or sit; prefer other flex options.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization (tied Bijan league-high), 19% target share last 10 games, 25+ touches 3 of last 4. Friendly Chargers D.
LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 utilization, 26% target share, 100% RB red-zone touches W1. CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC. Out-routed Gainwell.
items.why: Passing + RZ monopoly + soft run matchup.
items.implication: Start with confidence as high-upside RB.
items.opportunity: Routes, targets, goal-line work all elevated.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career avg with Wentz. Bears D allowed 10+ YPT last week.
items.why: Massive volume with Wentz + favorable matchup.
items.opportunity: High target share continues with Wentz starting.

items.text: LOVE DeVonta Smith @ TEN: 27% target share, 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) W1. TEN allowed 85% catch rate/16 YPR; 6th-most PPG to WRs since last year.
HATE Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: Only 8% target share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ looks. SEA 3rd-fewest PPG to WRs since last season.
items.implication: Sit or fade in tough spot.

items.text: HATE Brian Thomas Jr. @ DEN: DEN 3rd-fewest yds/g to perimeter WRs, 2nd-lowest deep completion rate. Limited practice (shoulder).
items.why: Elite DEN perimeter coverage + shoulder concern.

items.text: LOVE Dak Prescott vs WAS: 21.3 PPG home last year; WAS torched for 14.5 YPC/3 TDs W1. DAL top-5 implied total (27) in high-total game.
items.why: Smash spot vs weak pass D + high total.
